articles.title: Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to US call to resume Ukraine peace talks
articles.description: Russia says it is "ready in principle" to resume peace talks and US President Donald Trump says the world is "the closest we've been" to ending the war.

articles.title: 'Targeted' attack on much-loved MP leaves Australian town heartbroken
articles.description: Locals describe the MP, who had to have both legs amputated, as a genuinely kind person who fought for the community.

articles.title: India 'cockroach' leaders who called on election chief to quit are freed from jail
articles.description: Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were accused of breaking into an unauthorised protest venue in Delhi.

articles.title: Swimmer, 65, killed in shark attack off South Africa's east coast
articles.description: Janine Lochrenberg, 65, was out on her daily morning swim with her club when she was attacked, her family tell the BBC.

articles.title: At least 153 people killed in drone strike on disputed Sudan-South Sudan region
articles.description: A drone strike on a fuel depot in a disputed region on the Sudan-South Sudan border has killed at least 153 people.

articles.title: Swimmer killed in shark attack in South Africa
articles.description: A 65-year-old woman was killed in a shark attack at a popular beach on South Africa's southeastern coast, local authorities said.

articles.title: Four soldiers from UN-backed force missing after gang attack in Haiti
articles.description: Four soldiers from El Salvador are unaccounted for after being attacked by heavily-armed gangs in Haiti.
